citation_entries.sentence: What we claim stands on texts you can check, and where our texts differ, we say so.
Two early texts tell of the death of Cyprian, our bishop:
Two early texts tell how our great bishop Cyprian was put to death on 14 September: a life by his deacon Pontius, and the Acta.
On his last night all his people kept watch at the door of the house where he was held.
Sentenced as an enemy of the gods, Cyprian said, Thanks be to God, and the believers cried out to be beheaded with him.
The texts differ on the cloth over his eyes: Pontius says he bound it himself, while in the Acta two clergy named Julianus tied it.
And so the blessed Cyprian suffered martyrdom.
Our own pastoral voice is quiet from Cyprian's death in 258 to Augustine's ordination in 391, and a few old sermons from those years have not yet been weighed.
What an ordinary believer felt from inside is almost never ours to give you.

text:
What we claim stands on texts you can check, and where our texts differ, we say so. Two early texts tell of the death of Cyprian, our bishop:

Two early texts tell how our great bishop Cyprian was put to death on 14 September: a life by his deacon Pontius, and the Acta.

On his last night all his people kept watch at the door of the house where he was held.

Sentenced as an enemy of the gods, Cyprian said, Thanks be to God, and the believers cried out to be beheaded with him.

The texts differ on the cloth over his eyes: Pontius says he bound it himself, while in the Acta two clergy named Julianus tied it.

And so the blessed Cyprian suffered martyrdom.. Our own pastoral voice is quiet from Cyprian's death in 258 to Augustine's ordination in 391, and a few old sermons from those years have not yet been weighed. What an ordinary believer felt from inside is almost never ours to give you.
